Everybody now wants to own the business context that AI agents run on: @Sap  @microsoft.com  @Google  @Tableau  and now @zoho.com 

With its new Zoho Analytics release, Zoho builds the context first, with an ontology and a semantic layer, then puts agents on top.

My blog post covers what Zoho announced and the market it lands in, from SAP’s knowledge graph to Apache Ossie and headless BI.

Is it enough to stand out? Read the post to find out👇

#Zoho #ZohoAnalytics #AgenticAI #SemanticLayer
